title: Yeah cool main pop
text: I really didn't think the deadool box was worth the price of the box. Yeah cool main pop, but the 2 other additions were rather disappointing. I didn't get the keychain some reviewers reference so maybe that'd make it better. I have subscribed to the marvel funko since it started a few years back, but this seems to show its lost the soul it used to capture.  Alas. Maybe it will pick up but for now I unsubscribed.
label: negative
